name: Free Classroom Feedback Study Thesis Defense PowerPoint Template
description: An editable thesis defense for presenting a classroom feedback study through its question, method, illustrative evidence, limits, and next inquiry.
longDescription: This original eight-slide classroom feedback thesis defense helps researchers present a focused question, conceptual frame, study design, illustrative evidence, interpretation, limitations, contribution, and discussion prompt. Its distinctive editorial system combines a narrow evidence spine, offset annotation fields, and large native-shape quotation markers on a warm paper canvas. All text and shapes are editable. Every sample number is an illustrative placeholder; replace all examples with verified research before presenting.
cover: What changes when feedback is usable?
A research-defense framework for questions, evidence, limits, and next inquiry.

story.title: Define the feedback moment
story.body: Ask how learners interpret a specific kind of feedback in a bounded classroom setting.

story.title: Connect action to interpretation
story.body: Separate what the teacher communicates from what the learner understands and tries next.

story.title: Make the comparison credible
story.body: Describe a hypothetical observation plan, participant boundary, consent process, and analysis approach.

story.title: Show the signal, then its limit
story.body: Use clearly labeled placeholder observations to demonstrate how a finding could be presented.

story.title: Explain what the pattern may mean
story.body: Link observations to the question while keeping alternative explanations visible.
points: Specificity may support a next action
Timing may explain part of the pattern

story.title: Bound the claim before extending it
story.body: State where sampling, observation, measurement, and classroom context constrain inference.

story.title: End with a testable next question
story.body: Summarize the proposed contribution and invite scrutiny of the strongest alternative explanation.
points: Test it in a new setting
